title: Home Assistant
intro: The hub announces itself to Home Assistant over MQTT (discovery): every point shows up in HA as a device with its sensors. HA and the hub must use the same MQTT broker, with the MQTT integration on in HA.
connected: The hub is connected to broker {uri}.
connectedDefault: The hub is connected to the broker.
notConnected: The device isn't connected to an MQTT broker — HA won't see it. Enter the broker address below.
mapTitle: What to pick in Home Assistant's Energy dashboard
notDay: Pick the sensors without “(Day)”: they only grow and HA works out days and months itself. “(Day)” sensors reset at midnight — they are for cards, not for the Energy dashboard.
oldHub: Hubs before firmware 1.1.2: HA may not offer “Cost (Total)” and “Revenue (Total)” for the Energy dashboard — they carry the wrong statistics type. Firmware 1.1.2 fixes it and calls the second one Export value.
oldHubDemo: HA may not offer “Cost (Total)” and “Revenue (Total)” for the Energy dashboard: they carry the wrong statistics type.
noBroker: No broker set — MQTT is off, so Home Assistant won't see the hub. Enter the broker address below.
